business_summary: Darden Restaurants, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates full-service restaurants in the United States and Canada. The company operates under Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Chuy's, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, The Capital Grille, Seasons 52, Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Bahama Breeze, The Capital Burger, Darden and Darden Restaurants brand names. Darden Restaurants, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is based in Orlando, Florida.
business_summary_ko: Darden Restaurant, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국과 캐나다에서 풀 서비스 레스토랑을 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Chuy's, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, The Capital Grille, Seasons 52, Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Bahama Breeze, The Capital Burger, Darden 및 Darden 레스토랑 브랜드 이름으로 운영됩니다. Darden Restaurant, Inc.는 1938년에 설립되었으며 플로리다주 올랜도에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
